$comment: Defaults for npm run deploy (tools/deploy/deploy.mjs). Flags override them; see the README's Deploy section.
$encode: transfer compression of models, code and page: none | br | gzip. Lossless, undone by the browser: the game gets the same bytes.
$meshopt: model compression: off | lossless (EXT_meshopt_compression, the same vertices at runtime) | quantize (also rounds positions and normals: smaller, not bit-exact).
$textures: texture re-encoding, same resolution and names: off | webp-lossless (the same pixels) | webp (lossy, at webpQuality).
$textureGlobs: which texture files the texture setting applies to, as globs on paths in dist/ (e.g. models/*.png). include first, then exclude.
